# TEC INDUSTRIES

TEC INDUSTRIES is a B2B industrial piping partner based in Vapi, Gujarat, supporting manufacturing plants and industrial projects across Gujarat and Pan-India. TEC positions its work around product-family review, technical documentation and project enquiry support.

## Brand and positioning
- Brand line: Built on Trust. Driven by Commitment.
- Tagline: Your Partner in Industrial Progress.
- Primary focus: Industrial piping solutions for manufacturing plants and industrial projects.
- Customer groups: manufacturing, chemical and pharma, textile, food and beverage, engineering companies, contractors, MEP/plumbing contractors, plant maintenance, procurement teams, project consultants, dealers and distributors.

## Approved PPR information currently listed on the website
- Pipe-system colours: green and blue.
- Pipe construction cue: triple-layer PPR.
- Nominal outside-diameter range: 20 mm–630 mm.
- Available nominal pressure classes: PN06, PN10 and PN16.
- PPR pipes and coordinated fitting families are presented for project discussion.
- Final selection and rating must be confirmed against temperature, size, wall thickness, joining method and current manufacturer documentation.
- Exact drawings, dimensions, SDR mappings, wall thicknesses, SKU codes, pressure-temperature data and current technical literature are issued or confirmed against the project requirement.

## Material-selection guidance
TEC can begin with PPR where the confirmed operating envelope is suitable. PPH, PP-RCT and PPCH may be discussed as alternate PP material families when the actual application, service conditions and current manufacturer documents support that review. Material selection is not a substitute for a project calculation, compatibility review or system approval.

## Project enquiry inputs
A useful industrial piping enquiry includes application or service medium, nominal size or DN range, operating pressure or class, project location, approximate quantity and required delivery context. Procurement teams may request applicable drawings, technical literature and project documents through the contact route.
